Recent Headlines
Transforming Ideas Into Solutions That Improve Everyday Life
Our proprietary drug delivery solutions, consumer dispensing, dosing and protection technologies add value to some of the world’s most trusted and innovative brands, making an impact on the everyday lives of millions of patients and consumers around the globe.
Supporting Your BusinessA Collaborative and Comprehensive Approach
We help our customers go to market with support and services throughout the development process. From early concepts to commercialization, we partner with you every step of the way.
Awards & Recognition
We are recognized around the world for our innovative products, responsible behavior, commitment to the environment and good corporate governance. These awards are just a snapshot of Aptar’s impact.
How can we help?
We’re here to help with product development. Whether you’re working on a new product, looking to become a partner or everything in between.

## ANNOUNCEMENT

Cold Chain Technologies (“CCT”), a leading global provider of advanced thermal packaging and digital
monitoring solutions for the transportation of temperature-sensitive life sciences products, today
announced it has acquired Tower Cold Chain (“Tower”), a global provider of advanced passive reusable
cold chain solutions. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Cryopak is a complete cold chain packaging solutions provider specializing in the field of
temperature-controlled packaging. From needs assessment to package qualification, Cryopak handles
your packaging projects with one paramount goal: Maintaining the integrity of your products. Our
materials and processes cover the spectrum from converting EPS or fabricating boxes to manufacturing
phase change materials and temperature monitors.

* ### Helping the cannabis industry
  
  Prevent mold growth without drying out the cannabinoids and terpenes, and increase shelf life by
  transporting your products within the proper temperature and humidity ranges, with our
  specifically design pallet shippers and insulated boxes.
* ### Serving the Pharmaceutical Industry
  
  The pharmaceutical industry demands stringent monitoring of your payload’s temperature. Just one
  degree off can spoil products and cause financial losses. Don’t risk it. Let Cryopak provide you
  with accurate monitoring solutions.
* ### Providing Premium Retail Products
  
  Our Ice-Pak Brand is an integral part of any lunch box or cooler. From bottles and blankets to hot
  packs and coolers, we have the solution for your every need.
* ### Keeping Food & Beverage Cold
  
  There’s no use in crying over spoiled milk. With Cryopak´s temperature and humidity monitoring
  solutions, you can track the enviroment of your product in real-time.

Cryopak is a complete cold chain packaging solutions provider specializing in the field of
temperature-controlled packaging. From needs assessment to package qualification, Cryopak handles
your packaging projects with one paramount goal: Maintaining the integrity of your products. Our
materials and processes cover the spectrum from converting EPS or fabricating boxes to manufacturing
phase change materials and temperature monitors.

  Prevent mold growth without drying out the cannabinoids and terpenes, and increase shelf life by
  transporting your products within the proper temperature and humidity ranges, with our
  specifically design pallet shippers and insulated boxes.
* ### Serving the Pharmaceutical Industry
  
  The pharmaceutical industry demands stringent monitoring of your payload’s temperature. Just one
  degree off can spoil products and cause financial losses. Don’t risk it. Let Cryopak provide you
  with accurate monitoring solutions.
* ### Providing Premium Retail Products
  
  Our Ice-Pak Brand is an integral part of any lunch box or cooler. From bottles and blankets to hot
  packs and coolers, we have the solution for your every need.
* ### Keeping Food & Beverage Cold
  
  There’s no use in crying over spoiled milk. With Cryopak´s temperature and humidity monitoring
  solutions, you can track the enviroment of your product in real-time.

Le contrôle de la température est un enjeu majeur. Cette maîtrise est cruciale pour la vie et le
vivant et

# 45 ANS
# d’expertise et d’innovation

Depuis le premier jour, nous accompagnons nos clients en innovant pour maîtriser la température.
Une aventure familiale devenue collective, portée par des collaborateurs, partenaires et clients
engagés.
Grâce à la thermodynamique, nous faisons de la maîtrise du froid et du chaud un levier concret de
décarbonation, au service de la santé, de l’industrie, de l’alimentation et de la logistique
responsable.
**THERMODYNAMICS FOR LIFE. **

## Optimize your cold chain management for last-mile home delivery with Tempack

Tempack’s passive temperature-controlled solutions are specifically developed to support **food
last-mile delivery operations**, ensuring that chilled and frozen products maintain stability from
fulfilment preparation through to final distribution.
Our systems help retailers, e-grocery operators and logistics providers preserve product quality
while improving operational efficiency in urban delivery environments.

**Preservation of Freshness and Quality**

Our packaging maintains the precise temperature ranges required for chilled and frozen food
distribution, preventing spoilage and preserving product quality throughout last-mile delivery
routes.

**Guaranteed Cold Chain Integrity**

Designed specifically for last-mile deliveries, our packaging solutions maintain stable temperatures
even in varying external conditions, ensuring cold chain integrity from the distribution or
fulfilment centre to the customer.

**Reduced Spoilage and Waste**

By protecting chilled and frozen products during home delivery, our solutions minimize product loss,
reducing waste and supporting both sustainability efforts and cost savings for retailers.

**Compliance with Home Delivery Standards**

All packaging solutions are built to meet the necessary regulations and best practices for
transporting perishable goods, ensuring compliance and reducing the risk of product returns or
customer dissatisfaction upon delivery.

**Traceability and monitoring**

Our packaging solutions can integrate monitoring technologies to provide visibility across food
distribution routes, suporting quality assurance and operational control in last-mile
delivery.  Depending on operational needs, features may include temperature alerts, location
visibility and connectivity tools that help logistics teams maintain product integrity throughout
delivery.

## Primary focus: food retail, e-grocery and last-mile food logistics

### **Distribution and Fulfilment Centres:**

We support **food retail fulfilment operations and e-grocery distribution centres**, helping
maintain temperature stability from order preparation and staging through to last-mile dispatch.
Our solutions are designed to perform in high-volume food logistics environments, enabling efficient
handling of chilled and frozen products across store-based picking, dark store operations and
automated fulfilment systems.

### **Food Retail – From store to “doorstep”:**

Our temperature-controlled solutions enable food retailers such as supermarkets, hypermarkets,
convenience networks and meal kit providers to manage reliable **grocery delivery operations**.
They ensure safe product distribution while improving efficiency across store-based picking,**
fulfilment processes and last-mile delivery.**

### **Online Grocers / eCommerce Home Delivery:**

As e-grocery operations continue to expand and delivery networks become more complex, maintaining
consistent temperature control has become a critical operational priority.
Our passive enable online grocers preserve the stability of** chilled and frozen products** across
fulfilment preparation, route consolidation and **last-mile delivery**. Designed for high-frequency
distribution models, they contribute to improved logistics efficiency while enabling more
sustainable** reusable delivery systems**.

### **Logistics for Last-Mile Delivery:**

We collaborate with** last-mile food logistics providers t**o enable reliable temperature control
across increasingly complex urban delivery operations.
Our passive solutions are designed to perform in multi-stop distribution environments, helping
operators manage **mixed delivery loads, variable dwell times** and the operational pressures
associated with high-frequency food delivery routes.
They are also suitable for emerging delivery models such as parcel networks, food lockers,
click-and-collect systems and alternative micro-mobility fleets.

### **Other temperature-controlled distribution applications **

Our temperature-controlled solutions can also be adapted to support selected temperature-sensitive
distribution needs beyond food logistics, including specialised medical or laboratory transport
scenarios.

## Customized packaging solutions for the transport and delivery of chilled and frozen food products

Our passive temperature-controlled solutions are engineered to perform in real** food distribution
environments**, where route duration, delivery density and temperature exposure conditions can vary
significantly.
We develop modular systems adapted to specific logistics models, enabling more efficient handling of
chilled and frozen products while supporting **scalable last-mile delivery operations**.
By combining thermal performance with operational practicality, our solutions help reduce complexity
in stock management and contribute to improved distribution efficienc

About Us

## The speed, scale, and savvy to keep you moving.

We engineer cutting-edge transport climate control solutions with sustainability and the customer
experience in mind. Our solutions keep the industry moving forward to make a lasting impact.

[truck-on-road-bridge.png]

## We move the industry forward.

As the inventor of the transport refrigeration unit, we’ve been making it our mission for over 80
years to provide sustainable temperature-controlled transport solutions.

[Our legacy ][117]
[View Looking Out From Inside Of Refrigerator As Woman Opens Door And Unpacks Shopping Bag Of Food]
[impact-icon.png]

## We engineer solutions that move the industry — and the world — forward.

Our commitment to sustainability extends to the environmental impacts of our people, operations, and
products and services.

[Our sustainability mission ][118]
25%

More than 25% of global food waste can be reduced by applying cold chain technology.

you need — whenever and wherever you are — with factory-trained expert service and genuine Thermo
King parts.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.

* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.

* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.

* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the

## Precision Cold Chain Solutions: Trusted Temperature Control from -40°C to +40°C

At Allwin, we recognize that each industry has unique cold chain requirements. Whether it's life
sciences, healthcare, or food distribution, our advanced solutions guarantee the safe, efficient
transport of temperature-sensitive goods, customized to meet your specific needs.

o
[Banner_2.webp]

## Building a Sustainable Future with Precision Logistics

With a commitment to sustainability, Allwin combines precision logistics with eco-friendly
practices, reducing waste and energy consumption while delivering excellence in cold chain
management.

o

About Us

## A Strategic Vision for Long-Term Success

At Allwin, we are a dynamic startup with a strong foundation in temperature-controlled packaging
solutions, supported by the expertise of our parent company, known for producing PUF insulated ice
boxes and shippers. We’re committed to ensuring the safe and reliable transport of
temperature-sensitive goods through innovative solutions designed to meet the demands of modern cold
chain needs.

Discover Why We’re the Leading Choice for Cold Chain Solutions. Our focus goes beyond packaging;
it's about ensuring customer safety, preserving product quality, and empowering you to keep your
commitments. With our skilled team, advanced technology, reliable processes, and specialized
expertise, we deliver eco-friendly and trusted thermal packaging solutions tailored to your needs.

[About Us][38]

Our Products

## Allwin Cold Chain Solutions: Your Partner in Reliable Temperature - Controlled Packaging and
## logistics

At Allwin Cold Chain Solutions, we specialize in providing innovative cold chain packaging products
crucial for industries that rely on temperature control. Our range includes:

[Cold Chain Courier Shipper ][39]

Lightweight, insulated boxes ideal for shipping temperature-sensitive products.

[Read More ][40]
[pallete-shipper]

Designed for bulk shipments requiring temperature control.

[Read More ][42]

(-40°C to +40°C*) Phase Change Material pads that maintain specific temperatures for long durations
(up to 144*). A big range of standard sizes and temperature ranges to suit all requirements.

[Read More ][44]
[vip]
[Reusable Shipper ][45]

Ultra-efficient, returnable cold chain packaging for highly sensitive goods.

[Read More ][46]
[Data Loggers]
[Data Loggers ][47]

Devices for monitoring and recording temperature during transit.

[Read More ][48]
[Returnable Cold Chain Boxes: Built to Last ]
[Returnable Cold Chain Boxes: Built to Last ][49]

Our returnable cold chain boxes ensure lasting durability and thermal protection, keeping products
fresh and secure.

[Read More ][50]

## Frequently Asked Questions

What services does CLEARFAST offer?

*CLEARFAST provides comprehensive logistics solutions including air and sea freight forwarding,
custom clearance, warehousing, transportation management, supply chain consultancy, and specialized
services for handling over-dimensional cargo, temperature-sensitive goods, and dangerous goods. Our
global network ensures your cargo reaches its destination efficiently and safely*

How does CLEARFAST ensure timely delivery of cargo?

*Our commitment to timely delivery is supported by an advanced transportation management system,
offering real-time tracking and reporting. Our strong relationships with major carriers and a 24/7
service for time-critical consignments allow us to provide reliable and expedient transport
solutions across our global network.*

Can CLEARFAST handle the logistics for specialized cargo?

*Yes, CLEARFAST has extensive experience in handling specialized cargo such as Over Dimensional
Cargo (ODC), project cargo, temperature-controlled shipments, and Dangerous Goods (DG). Our skilled
team offers tailored solutions, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and delivering your
cargo with the utmost care.*

* [Who We Are][1]
  [Who We Are][2]
  Who We Are
  
  Cold Summit is a mission driven company. We combine innovation with deep expertise and strategic
  supply chain insight to deliver cold storage solutions that go beyond traditional development.
  
  [Our Mission][3]
  Our Mission
  
  Cold Summit’s mission is to reshape the global cold chain by delivering innovative,
  industry-leading cold storage solutions.
  
  [Learn More][4]
  [Company History][5]
  Company History
  
  Founded in 2019, Cold Summit has evolved into a full-spectrum solutions provider, offering
  advisory, development, technology integration, and asset management to drive innovation,
  efficiency, and sustainability worldwide.
  
  [Learn More][6]
  [Our Team][7]
  Our Team
  
  Cold Summit integrates construction, logistics, supply chain strategy, and port operations with
  project management, investment, and finance expertise, delivering a seamless development
  experience.
  
  [Learn More][8]
  [Our Offices][9]
  Our Offices
  
  Cold Summit is headquartered in Sun Valley, Idaho, with offices in St. Augustine, FL, Norfolk, VA,
  and Amsterdam, NL, supporting our expanding global presence.
  
  [Learn More][10]
  [Cold Summit Giving][11]
  Cold Summit Giving
  
  Cold Summit Giving is our commitment to supporting local communities where we develop.
  
  [Learn More][12]
* [What We Do][13]
  [What We Do][14]
  [Pre-Project Advisory Services][15]
  Advisory Services
  
  Cold Summit provides expert advisory services to shape and achieve cold chain strategies.
  
  [Learn More][16]
  [Real Estate Development][17]
  Real Estate Development
  
  Cold Summit manages the full facility lifecycle, from conception to construction, specializing in
  temperature-controlled facilities like refrigerated warehouses, ASRS, food-grade production, and
  ultra-low temperature pharmaceutical storage.
  
  [Learn More][18]
  [Build-to-Suit Services][19]
  Build-to-Suit Services
  
  Cold Summit offers comprehensive solutions, integrating advisory, real estate development,
  construction, and financing to mitigate risk and ensure seamless execution beyond traditional
  design-build contractors.
  
  [Learn More][20]
  [Construction Services][21]
  Construction Services
  
  Cold Summit delivers expert construction management for cold storage projects, ensuring on-time,
  on-budget, and safety-focused execution.
  
  [Learn More][22]
  [Financing & Asset Management][23]
  Financing & Asset Management
  
  Cold Summit combines investment expertise and technical knowledge to execute complex financing
  solutions. We optimize asset performance and value for investors throughout a facility’s
  lifecycle.
  
  [Learn More][24]
  [Innovation][25]
  Innovation
  
  Cold Summit challenges convention, driving innovation in cold storage facility design and
  technology. We collaborate with partners to advance energy efficiency, racking systems, and blast
  freezing solutions.
  
  [Learn More][26]
* [Our Projects][27]
  [Our Projects][28]
  [Dallas I][29]
  Cold Summit Dallas I
  
  Cold Summit Dallas I was the first speculative, multi-tenant, flexible-temperature cold storage
  facility in the U.S.
  
  [LEARN MORE][30]

  Cold Summit Phoenix
  
  Cold Summit Phoenix is a next-generation cold storage facility designed for flexibility,
  efficiency, and rapid access to the Southwest market.
  
  [Learn More][32]

  Cold Summit Chicago I
  
  Cold Summit Chicago I is a state-of-the-art, multi-tenant, flexible-temperature cold storage
  facility strategically located in the Midwest’s key distribution hub.
  
  [Learn More][34]
  [Wilmington NC][35]
  Port of Wilmington
  
  Cold Summit Wilmington is a modern, flexible-temperature cold storage facility located at the Port
  of Wilmington, NC. Cold Summit Wilmington is available for lease.
  
  [Learn More][36]
  [Dallas II][37]
  Cold Summit Dallas II
  
  Cold Summit Dallas II is a next-generation, multi-tenant cold storage facility located in the
  heart of the Dallas-Fort Worth logistics corridor. Dallas II is available for lease.
  
  [Learn More][38]

  Savannah Build-to-Suit
  
  Cold Summit Savannah is a custom build-to-suit cold storage facility strategically located near

Reliable cold chain solutions for food and pharmaceutical shipments across the UK, Europe, and
worldwide.

[Speak to an Expert][13]

Welcome to Cool Cargo UK — your trusted specialist in cold chain logistics.


We provide temperature‑controlled transport solutions for chilled, frozen, and ambient goods,
ensuring your food and pharmaceutical shipments are delivered safely, compliantly, and on time.


With services by air, road, and sea, Cool Cargo supports UK‑to‑EU and global shipments with full
temperature control, live tracking, and expert handling.

# The specialists in Cold Chain Packaging and Temperature Mapping in Australia.

CoolPac are leading specialists in pharmaceutical cold chain packaging and temperature mapping
across Australia.

We don’t just supply, we design, manufacture, validate, and monitor complete Cold Chain delivery and
storage systems.  Whether you are a pharmaceutical manufacturer, food distributor, transporter, or
an end-user of temperature-critical products, we treat every requirement as a unique Cold Chain
project.

We understand that when you buy temperature controlled packaging, you need reliability, compliance,
and speed.  That’s why our design and implementation processes are fully compliant with all GDP and
GWP industry guidelines.  Our specialised solutions are engineered to minimise risk and maximise
profitability of your sensitive goods.

Ready to secure your Cold Chain logistics?  You can order pharma cold chain packaging and other
specialised solutions through our dedicated team, backed by local expertise and support.

Our Cold Chain solutions, are fully compliant with all GDP and GWP industry guidelines and every
clients’ delivery and storage requirements are treated as a unique Cold Chain project.

[[cold chain packaging][cold chain packaging]][68]

### [Cold Chain Packaging][69]

[][70]

### [Temperature Monitoring][71]

[][72]

### [Temperature Mapping][73]

The difficulties in storing and distributing cold chain vaccines, biologics, and other
temperature-sensitive medicines continue to pose a significant challenge for healthcare providers
worldwide.

[cold chain brings peace of mind][cold chain brings peace of mind]
 

**Learn how CoolPac can help your business**

## Temperature Packaging Systems (TPS)

To facilitate the distribution of medicines and vaccines at these temperatures, CoolPac has
developed a range of Temperature Packing Systems (TPS) designed to assist companies in their
logistics.

Our Temperature Packing Systems are designed and manufactured in Australia.  They are used by local
and international pharmaceutical companies to transport medicines across Australia and overseas to
the USA, Europe and beyond.


[View Our Range][74]

## Regulatory Compliance

The TPS are pre-qualified and used by companies who must comply to TGA or US-FDA. Sometimes
companies require “special” qualification to more stringent conditions. This qualification is
conducted in bespoke environmental chambers, in CoolPac’s extensive laboratory. This extra
qualification is often used by companies to reduce the risk of unforeseen problems occurring during
transport.

[Regulatory Compliance][Regulatory Compliance]

### Rigorous compliance allows us to deliver peace of mind when delivering cold chain products and
### services to the pharmaceutical and bio

# [GeneDx Investors Face August 3 Deadline in Federal Securities Lawsuit][9]

Investors who lost more than $100,000 in GeneDx Holdings Corp. stock between April 2025 and May 2026
have until August 3 to apply as lead plaintiffs in a pending class action lawsuit. The case, filed
in the U.S. District Court for the District of Connecticut, centers on allegations of undisclosed
material information.

By **[Money Talk][10]**·Jul 25·2 min read
[GeneDx Investors Face August 3 Deadline in Federal Securities Lawsuit]

lawsuit, pending in the Southern District of New York, centers on allegations of misleading
disclosures in the company’s offering documents.

lawsuit filed in the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey.

Investors who lost more than $100,000 in Futu Holdings Limited securities between May 24, 2023, and
May 27, 2026, have until August 25, 2026, to file lead plaintiff applications. The class action
lawsuit, pending in the Southern District of New York, alleges the company misled shareholders
regarding its regulatory compliance in mainland China.

three-year window.

Investors who lost more than $100,000 in PicS N.V. stock following the company's January 2026

As an interdisciplinary brand and design innovation consultancy, Creativeans bridges strategy,
creativity, business thinking, and technology to help organisations build brands that matter. We
believe that strong brands are not built through design alone, but through a deep understanding of
the business, its people, market opportunities, customer needs, and long-term growth ambitions.

Guided by our proprietary methodologies such as [**BrandBuilder^{®}**][30] and [**EDIT Design
Thinking^{®}**][31], we work across brand strategy, identity design, packaging, UI/UX,
communication, and experience design to create solutions that are both meaningful and actionable.
Our approach allows us to uncover insights, define clear brand directions, and translate strategy
into tangible touchpoints that connect with audiences across every stage of the brand journey.

There’s a direct connection between a company’s brand and its success. A strong brand provides a
significant competitive advantage that differentiates it from its competitors.

As brand builders, we combine strategic and creative thinking to offer an integrated and holistic
approach to increase brand value. We help to audit and position your brand, express your brand
identity and eventually, execute your brand touch points. In other words, the whole nine yards. We
leave nothing to chance.

The success of a business’s brand goes hand in hand with continuous innovation. Through our
interdisciplinary use of analytical tools and creative processes, we help businesses uncover and
take advantage of untapped opportunities in the market and transform their business.

## Interdisciplinary
## Brand & Design Innovation Consultancy

[See All Solutions][29]

As an interdisciplinary brand and design innovation consultancy, Creativeans bridges strategy,
creativity, business thinking, and technology to help organisations build brands that matter. We
believe that strong brands are not built through design alone, but through a deep understanding of
the business, its people, market opportunities, customer needs, and long-term growth ambitions.

Guided by our proprietary methodologies such as [**BrandBuilder^{®}**][30] and [**EDIT Design
Thinking^{®}**][31], we work across brand strategy, identity design, packaging, UI/UX,
communication, and experience design to create solutions that are both meaningful and actionable.
Our approach allows us to uncover insights, define clear brand directions, and translate strategy
into tangible touchpoints that connect with audiences across every stage of the brand journey.

Branding
1Branding

There’s a direct connection between a company’s brand and its success. A strong brand provides a
significant competitive advantage that differentiates it from its competitors.

As brand builders, we combine strategic and creative thinking to offer an integrated and holistic
approach to increase brand value. We help to audit and position your brand, express your brand
identity and eventually, execute your brand touch points. In other words, the whole nine yards. We
leave nothing to chance.

The success of a business’s brand goes hand in hand with continuous innovation. Through our
interdisciplinary use of analytical tools and creative processes, we help businesses uncover and
take advantage of untapped opportunities in the market and transform their business.

# Temperature Assured.
# Life Enhanced.

## Protecting the path from innovation to patient.

#### End-to-end temperature-controlled shipping solutions.

CSafe has been committed to ensuring life-enhancing products reach patients around the globe since
1979. With a patient-first approach, deep industry expertise, and focus on innovation, CSafe is
dedicated to providing high-quality temperature-controlled solutions.

[ Our Story ][53]

###### 47

###### Years of proven expertise

###### 185+

###### Countries reached

###### 75+

###### Global network locations

###### 10B+

###### Doses safely delivered in CSafe products

[

### For Pharma

Where innovation meets innovation. End-to-end shipping solutions for every stage of your journey,
from R&D and clinical trials to commercial distribution.

Learn More

][54] [

### For Logistics

Global support and availability. Whether by land or air, our worldwide network, innovative and
easy-to-use solutions, and real time shipment visibility are ready to support you.

Learn More

][55] [

### For Cell & Gene Therapy

From discovery to patient. Supporting your evolving commercialization needs with the industry's
broadest range of high-performance CGT cold chain shipping solutions.

Learn More

][56]

#### Our product portfolio
#### – excellence at every turn.

CSafe offers a comprehensive portfolio of temperature-controlled shipping solutions engineered for
exceptional performance and reliability. Our offerings include active and passive bulk air cargo,
parcel shipping, cell and gene, specialty and advanced digital solutions.

[ Learn More ][57]

#### Explore our market-leading parcels - CSafe Advanced

CSafe Advanced is our new parcel, engineered to deliver consistent performance and sustainability
while reducing operational complexity and total cost of ownership.
* Reduce freight costs by up to 25%
* True ISTA 7D 72 Hour Performance
* Reduce packout time by 60-75%
* Sustainable reuse options

[ Learn More ][63]
[CSafe Advanced Mockup]

### Powered by CSafe Connect

### for ultimate visibility.

###### Your cold chain shipments are protected with real-time visibility, backed by TracSafe data
###### loggers and CSafe Connect. Access predictive insights, real-time shipment data and AI-powered
###### analytics to make informed decisions and stay ahead.

  Available for bulk orders, our professional food delivery bags are fully OEM/ODM customizable to
  meet your brand’s needs. Factory-direct and built for commercial use, you can add your logo,
  select sizes, and design custom solutions for restaurants, catering services, and delivery
  platforms. With reliable quality, competitive pricing, and scalable production, we make it easy
  for businesses to upgrade their delivery operations.

  Enhance road safety with our B2B-customized helmets, crafted in our factory for food delivery
  professionals. They feature durable construction, reflective decals for visibility, and a
  comfortable ventilation system. Snap-on shields and side logo printing are included, with DOT,
  ECE, and CE certifications for top-tier quality assurance.
* [Parcel Delivery Bags][119]
  The Logistics Sorting Bags, made in the Yangchun factory, are designed to help logistics companies
  simplify parcel sorting and delivery. Each bag can be customized in size, material, and with
  company logo, giving business some flexibility to create solution that fits their workflow. With
  factory-direct production and support for bulk orders, these bags helps courier companies,
  warehouses, and delivery services improve efficiency while keeping a neat and professional look.
* [Cold Chain Insulated Packaging][120]
  Explore the range of cold chain delivery bags — insulated soft-structure bags made to keep fresh
  produce, groceries, and medical stuff at the right temperature during delivery. Each bag can be
  fully customized in size, material, and even branding, giving businesses some flexibility to
  create solution that kinda fits their workflow. Perfect for bulk wholesale orders, these bags
  helps companies meet fast global fulfillment needs while keeping things reliable and consistent.
  Factory-direct production makes pricing competitive, and the team can scale up quickly if more
  bags are needed, making it easier for restaurants, pharmacies, and logistics providers to actually
  upgrade their delivery operations without too much hassle.
* [Rider Uniform][121]
  All-weather protection for motorcycle food couriers. Durable exterior combined with heat-retaining
  interior lining. Reflective safety strips improve visibility. Adjustable waists, wrists , and
  ankles ensure optimal fit. Waterproof and windproof. Large front pouch fits order slips and pens.
  Finished in your brand colors with reflective logo printing.

compliant transportation across all modes.

Our expertise assures that all hazardous materials are properly classified, packed, and documented.
This commitment provides our clients with reliable and secure dangerous goods logistics solutions.

# Leader in Protective Packaging & Cold Chain Solutions


[Learn About EFP][22]
[Feature1]

### Protective Packaging

## Protection and Distribution

When properly engineered, there is no substitute for quality in protective packaging. EFP offers a
broad range of materials with physical properties that allow packaging designers to meet the many
challenges of protection and distribution. With the appropriate engineering design considerations,
EFP will provide you with truly cost-effective protective packaging.

[Explore][23]

[Feature2]

### Temperature Solutions

## Ideation to Conception

Consultation, design, and packaging design services are at your fingertips with EFP’s Temperature
Solutions Group. We offer a complete cold-chain product line from ideation to conception. Our
talented Center of Excellence Packaging Engineers has a firm commitment to problem-solving,
consistently producing excellent results for our customers.

[Explore][24]

[Gabriel Jimenez Jin4w1hqgl4 Unsplash 2]

### Sustainability

## The Future of Packaging is Circular

EFP is committed to taking a 360-degree approach to sustainability. We’re evolving the materials we
use, the takeback systems we create and the industry-driven partnerships we pursue to keep
sustainability in our line of sight and spark industry-wide lasting change.

[Explore][25]

# Decades of Premier Packaging Solutions

Founded in 1954, EFP, LLC is a leader in protective packaging, consumer packaging, cold chain
solutions, and packaging supply chain services. Headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana, EFP has locations
in Evansville, Indiana; Howell, Michigan; La Vergne, Tennessee; Decatur, Alabama; Bishopville, South
Carolina; and Casa Grande, Arizona providing coverage to the west coast and mid-America from Canada
to the Gulf of America. EFP is owned by J.B. Poindexter & Co., a privately held, diversified
manufacturing company with operating subsidiaries throughout North America. EFP is committed to
innovating current products, creating sustainable solutions, and providing services that support our
corporate purpose of Protecting What Matters.

# Leader in Protective Packaging & Cold Chain Solutions


[Learn About EFP][22]
[Feature1]

### Protective Packaging

## Protection and Distribution

When properly engineered, there is no substitute for quality in protective packaging. EFP offers a
broad range of materials with physical properties that allow packaging designers to meet the many
challenges of protection and distribution. With the appropriate engineering design considerations,
EFP will provide you with truly cost-effective protective packaging.

[Explore][23]

[Feature2]

### Temperature Solutions

## Ideation to Conception

Consultation, design, and packaging design services are at your fingertips with EFP’s Temperature
Solutions Group. We offer a complete cold-chain product line from ideation to conception. Our
talented Center of Excellence Packaging Engineers has a firm commitment to problem-solving,
consistently producing excellent results for our customers.

[Explore][24]

[Gabriel Jimenez Jin4w1hqgl4 Unsplash 2]

### Sustainability

## The Future of Packaging is Circular

EFP is committed to taking a 360-degree approach to sustainability. We’re evolving the materials we
use, the takeback systems we create and the industry-driven partnerships we pursue to keep
sustainability in our line of sight and spark industry-wide lasting change.

[Explore][25]

# Decades of Premier Packaging Solutions

Founded in 1954, EFP, LLC is a leader in protective packaging, consumer packaging, cold chain
solutions, and packaging supply chain services. Headquartered in Elkhart, Indiana, EFP has locations
in Evansville, Indiana; Howell, Michigan; La Vergne, Tennessee; Decatur, Alabama; Bishopville, South
Carolina; and Casa Grande, Arizona providing coverage to the west coast and mid-America from Canada
to the Gulf of America. EFP is owned by J.B. Poindexter & Co., a privately held, diversified
manufacturing company with operating subsidiaries throughout North America. EFP is committed to
innovating current products, creating sustainable solutions, and providing services that support our
corporate purpose of Protecting What Matters.

Elitech is a global company specializing in the R&D and manufacturing of instruments and control
systems. We focus on core technologies including temperature measurement, data logging and control,
industrial leak detection and vacuum solutions, as well as environmental particulate monitoring.
Elitech is committed to the development of infrared refrigerant sensors and optical scattering
particle sensors, and provides cloud-based system integration and industry-specific AI services.

Elitech iCold is a cloud-based platform designed for wireless data loggers, so technicians can
monitor temperature, humidity and locations of your products remotely in real time.

Elitech App pairs with Elitech products for convenient, intelligent device management. It has
real-time monitoring, connecting to related devices to let users remotely view operating status and
get alerts. With easy remote controls and personalized settings, plus a user-friendly interface,
beginners can also handle device operations well.

[Access Now][62]

[Thumb] Global Layout

Elitech has established subsidiaries in the UK, Brazil, and other regions, and set up production
bases in China and Thailand, providing localized service support to customers worldwide. Its
business covers over 120 countries globally.

[Thumb] Smart Manufacturing

Elitech boasts an industry-leading smart factory with an annual production capacity exceeding 7
million units, leveraging automation and intelligent technology to forge superior product quality.

[Thumb] Innovation Ability

Elitech holds a total of 368 patents and has participated in the development of 38 industry
standards. Its proprietary technologies, such as infrared refrigerant detection and light scattering
particulate matter detection, are at the forefront of the industry.

# Enhancing Cold Chain Excellence Through

Real-Time Monitoring
Data-Powered Insurance
Streamlined Inventory Mgt

We offer a comprehensive suite of services that cater to the unique needs of businesses dealing with
temperature-sensitive items.

[SCHEDULE A DEMO][14]

**Our Services**

We are committed to addressing every challenges that cold-chain
business owners may face in their operations.

Real-Time Monitoring Of Your Temperature-Sensitive Items

Our advanced technology allows you to monitor the humidity, temperature, and location of your
temperature-sensitive commodities and alerts you whenever deviation is detected. This enables you to
make immediate decisions to minimize product loss and maintain product integrity.

[LEARN MORE][15]

Data-Powered Insurance Security for Your Cold Chain Operations

We offer unparalleled insurance protection for your cold chain operations, this allows you to insure
your commodities that are often considered uninsurable risk. And in the face of unforeseen
situations, we provide you with data to back up your insurance claims.

[LEARN MORE][16]

Advanced Inventory Management

Navigate the difficulties of inventory management effortlessly with our dedicated software designed
to meet the unique demands of your business. Take control of your inventory with our inventory
management solution and streamline your operations today!

[LEARN MORE][17]

Reliable Cold Room and Cold Truck Rentals

Our innovative platform transforms the way you access temperature-controlled storage and transport.
It allows individuals and businesses to conveniently rent cold rooms or cold trucks anywhere across
Nigeria.

[LEARN MORE][18]

Provider For All Cold Chain Problems**

**Expand, Protect, And Streamline Your Operations With Figorr**

Count on us for accurate, reliable, and effective solutions crucial for the success of your cold
chain operations.

covered when losses occur.

risk of spoilage.

coverage for 3PL services.

# **Dinweys Frozen French Fries** **Factory（Hebei, China)**
* **Dinweys** offers a diverse range of cuts and sizes (Shoestring, Crinkle, Straight Cut) with
  **Grade A quality and guaranteed batch consistency.**
* We are dedicated to delivering the most suitable products and an **exceptional, worry-free service
  experience** to our global clients.

## Our Competitive Advantages
* **Unwavering Quality & Consistency:** Cutting-edge, fully automated production lines ensure
  premium, Grade A standards and reliable batch consistency for every shipment.
* **Stable Supply Chain:** Strategically located in China’s prime potato growing region,
  guaranteeing a year-round supply of high-quality raw materials.
* **Logistics Efficiency:** Only 300 km from Tianjin Port, significantly reducing transit times and
  lowering CIF transportation costs for global export.
* **Exceptional Price Competitiveness:** Highly automated, large-scale facilities combined with
  regional cost advantages ensure industry-leading pricing without compromising quality.
* **Dedicated Global Support:** Professional international sales and logistics teams provide 24/7
  comprehensive support, ensuring smooth communication and efficient order fulfillment.
* **Ease of Collaboration:** Just 200 km from Beijing, making factory audits, quality checks, and
  partnership meetings simple and convenient for international clients.

[China french fries factory]

## Frozen French Fries Production Process

The meticulous control over each stage ensures the superior quality and frying performance of
Dinweys’ frozen French fries. Our process is optimized for high dry matter retention, texture
consistency, and long-term stability.

### 1. Raw Material Selection: The Foundation of Quality

We begin with high-quality potatoes selected specifically for processing.

> **Key Advantage:** We exclusively use potato raw materials with a **dry matter content exceeding
> 22% (DM）> 22%)**. This crucial factor ensures a lower oil absorption rate and a crispier final
> texture.

### 2. High-Efficiency Cleaning & Peeling

Raw potatoes undergo thorough cleaning followed by a precise, hygienic peeling process.

> **Key Technique:** Peeling is performed using **high-temperature steam**, which minimizes surface
> damage and retains more of the potato’s valuable outer layer nutrients compared to mechanical
> abrasive methods.

### 3. Precision Cutting & Water Reduction

Potatoes are cut into uniform strips (e.g., standard 9mm or 12mm) using high-precision cutters.
Ripple-cut styles are also available.

> **Crucial Step (Dewatering):** Following blanching, we achieve a high **product dehydration rate
> of 25%–30%**. This optimized moisture removal is vital for minimizing oil absorption during frying
> and maximizing final crispiness.

### 4. Blanching & Color Protection

Strips are blanched at controlled temperatures (85–95°C) to remove excess starch and lock in color.

### 5. Pre-Frying (Par-Frying)

The fries are par-fried at approximately 160°C to develop the iconic golden color and form a
protective outer layer, enhancing flavor and crunch when cooked by the end-user.

### 6. Advanced Quick Freezing

Rapid freezing is critical for locking in flavor and texture.

> **Advanced Technology:** We utilize **tunnel freezing technology (Tunnel Freezer)** for rapid
> cooling. This method ensures that the core of the product is frozen quickly, preventing the
> formation of large ice crystals and maintaining optimal cell structure and texture stability.

### 7. Packaging & Quality Assurance

Fries are immediately sealed in protective, labeled packaging. Our standard products typically
contain only potatoes and vegetable oil, upholding a commitment to clean labeling.

[Frozen French Fries Production Process]

## Dinweys Frozen French Fries Production

*We use highly automated production lines, with an average of only 8–10 workers per shift on each
line.
Our production capacity reaches up to **30 tons per day**, with an **annual output of approximately
10,000 tons**.*

## Frozen French Fries Production Process

The meticulous control over each stage ensures the superior quality and frying performance of
Dinweys’ frozen French fries. Our process is optimized for high dry matter retention, texture
consistency, and long-term stability.

### 1. Raw Material Selection: The Foundation of Quality

We begin with high-quality potatoes selected specifically for processing.

> **Key Advantage:** We exclusively use potato raw materials with a **dry matter content exceeding
> 22% (DM）> 22%)**. This crucial factor ensures a lower oil absorption rate and a crispier final
> texture.

### 2. High-Efficiency Cleaning & Peeling

Raw potatoes undergo thorough cleaning followed by a precise, hygienic peeling process.

> **Key Technique:** Peeling is performed using **high-temperature steam**, which minimizes surface
> damage and retains more of the potato’s valuable outer layer nutrients compared to mechanical
> abrasive methods.

### 3. Precision Cutting & Water Reduction

Potatoes are cut into uniform strips (e.g., standard 9mm or 12mm) using high-precision cutters.
Ripple-cut styles are also available.

> **Crucial Step (Dewatering):** Following blanching, we achieve a high **product dehydration rate
> of 25%–30%**. This optimized moisture removal is vital for minimizing oil absorption during frying
> and maximizing final crispiness.

### 4. Blanching & Color Protection

Strips are blanched at controlled temperatures (85–95°C) to remove excess starch and lock in color.

### 5. Pre-Frying (Par-Frying)

The fries are par-fried at approximately 160°C to develop the iconic golden color and form a
protective outer layer, enhancing flavor and crunch when cooked by the end-user.

### 6. Advanced Quick Freezing

Rapid freezing is critical for locking in flavor and texture.

> **Advanced Technology:** We utilize **tunnel freezing technology (Tunnel Freezer)** for rapid
> cooling. This method ensures that the core of the product is frozen quickly, preventing the
> formation of large ice crystals and maintaining optimal cell structure and texture stability.

### 7. Packaging & Quality Assurance

Fries are immediately sealed in protective, labeled packaging. Our standard products typically
contain only potatoes and vegetable oil, upholding a commitment to clean labeling.

## AWARD WINNING DESIGN

Global Cold Chain Solutions has been awarded the 2022 Australian Enterprise Award for Best
Temperature-Controlled Supply Chain Solutions and the Distinction Award for Contributions to
Pandemic Relief.

## Global Supplier

GCCS has offices and warehouses in Australia, India, Germany and Malaysia. We supply global
companies with temperature packaging solutions.

## GMP Qualified

GCCS offers GDP and GMP qualified packaging solutions.

# Home

## **Global Cold Chain Solutions are specialists in GDP temperature controlled packaging and
## temperature monitoring for pharmaceuticals, healthcare and logistics. **

Global Cold Chain Solutions (GCCS) is an approved one-stop-provider of cold chain solutions focusing
on the requirements of the pharmaceutical and pharma logistics industry. Due to our global presence
we are close to our customers supporting their need for stable supply chains. Our highly flexible
GMP and GDP certified production concept allows for offering tailor-made solutions, thoroughly
tested, documented and taking into account optimising the cost of our customer‘s warehousing and
transportation.

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Courier Shipper Icon]

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Data Logger Icon]

**[DATA LOGGERS][16]**

**[TEMPERATURE MONITORING SYSTEMS][17]**

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Calibration Icon]

**[CALIBRATION SERVICES][18]**

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Qualification Icon]

**[QUALIFICATION SERVICES][19]**

[Transport Icon]

**[GMP TRANSPORT SOLUTIONS][20]**

[Global Cold Chain Solutions Innovation Icon]

**[INNOVATIONS][21]**

**OUR STORY**

Since 2003, *Global Cold Chain Solutions (GCCS) have specialised in GMP/GDP temperature packaging
design and GMP qualified temperature supply chain solutions. We have designed and qualified more
than 400 different models’ sizes and temperature ranges of pallets and shippers. We are proud to be
[delivering customised COVID-19 vaccine shipping solutions][22] from all our factories approved by
WHO and UNICEF for shipments into developing countries. *

*GGCS is continuously developing new and innovative solutions. Our current projects including active
solutions last mile, last 100 metres and critical care medical travel bags to allow patients to
travel with their medicines safely with them. Our pharmaceutical solutions include monitoring
medicine in patients’ fridges to ensure they consume their medicine daily and end-to-end [clinical
trial solutions][23].*

*Our speciality is customising designs to meet exact client requirements and more than 60% of our
manufacturing shippers are customised models. Our unique modular manufacturing enables us to be the
only company who can manufacture shippers from every known insulation material at every site
globally. We are one of only three cold chain packaging companies globally who manufactures their
own Phase Change Materials (PCM) and the only company who manufacturers PCM’s at every manufacturing
site. GCCS has the largest [packaging and environment testing][24] laboratory in Asia-Pacific with
five temperature chambers, compression testing, vibration and drop testing. Our testing facilities
include calibration, phase change material R&D and DSC testing.*

Global Cold Chain Solutions specialises in GDP and GMP compliant temperature-sensitive products and
services for the pharmaceutical, healthcare, bio-tech, exporters, clinical trial and logistics
industries in Australia, Asia Pacific, Germany and India. Certified [AS/NZS ISO 9001-2016][25], GCCS
team has a quality and customer-service focus to ensure temperature-sensitive products maintain
their integrity at all times during storage and distribution. GCCS products & services are of the
highest standard & quality. **Our validations meet GMP, GDP, CFR 21, WHO, MHRA, FDA and HACCP
compliances.** To learn more about our products and services, please [contact us][26].

## **Global Cold Chain Solutions are specialists in GDP temperature controlled packaging and
## temperature monitoring for pharmaceuticals, healthcare and logistics. **

Global Cold Chain Solutions (GCCS) is an approved one-stop-provider of cold chain solutions focusing
on the requirements of the pharmaceutical and pharma logistics industry. Due to our global presence
we are close to our customers supporting their need for stable supply chains. Our highly flexible
GMP and GDP certified production concept allows for offering tailor-made solutions, thoroughly
tested, documented and taking into account optimising the cost of our customer‘s warehousing and
transportation.

**OUR STORY**

Since 2003, *Global Cold Chain Solutions (GCCS) have specialised in GMP/GDP temperature packaging
design and GMP qualified temperature supply chain solutions. We have designed and qualified more
than 400 different models’ sizes and temperature ranges of pallets and shippers. We are proud to be
[delivering customised COVID-19 vaccine shipping solutions][22] from all our factories approved by
WHO and UNICEF for shipments into developing countries. *

*GGCS is continuously developing new and innovative solutions. Our current projects including active
solutions last mile, last 100 metres and critical care medical travel bags to allow patients to
travel with their medicines safely with them. Our pharmaceutical solutions include monitoring
medicine in patients’ fridges to ensure they consume their medicine daily and end-to-end [clinical
trial solutions][23].*

*Our speciality is customising designs to meet exact client requirements and more than 60% of our
manufacturing shippers are customised models. Our unique modular manufacturing enables us to be the
only company who can manufacture shippers from every known insulation material at every site
globally. We are one of only three cold chain packaging companies globally who manufactures their
own Phase Change Materials (PCM) and the only company who manufacturers PCM’s at every manufacturing
site. GCCS has the largest [packaging and environment testing][24] laboratory in Asia-Pacific with
five temperature chambers, compression testing, vibration and drop testing. Our testing facilities
include calibration, phase change material R&D and DSC testing.*

Global Cold Chain Solutions specialises in GDP and GMP compliant temperature-sensitive products and
services for the pharmaceutical, healthcare, bio-tech, exporters, clinical trial and logistics
industries in Australia, Asia Pacific, Germany and India. Certified [AS/NZS ISO 9001-2016][25], GCCS
team has a quality and customer-service focus to ensure temperature-sensitive products maintain
their integrity at all times during storage and distribution. GCCS products & services are of the
highest standard & quality. **Our validations meet GMP, GDP, CFR 21, WHO, MHRA, FDA and HACCP
compliances.** To learn more about our products and services, please [contact us][26].

# **Smart, Small, and Practical Electronics for Precision Monitoring**

Holtronic electronic temperature monitoring indicators give every shipment a clear, auditable record
of time and temperature — from dispatch to delivery.

Trusted across pharmaceuticals, food safety, diagnostics, and logistics.

[Explore Electronic Indicator Technology →][52]

✓ UK-designed & manufactured

✓ IATA & CE certified

✓ Calibration certificates included

✓ Used in 30+ countries

✓ GDP & cold chain compliant

[GDP temperature compliance CE certified RoHS REACH UKCA]

### Not just any temperature and time indicators, but bespoke solutions, addressing your specific
### operational requirements from concept to delivery.

At Holtronic, we simplify complex challenges by delivering bespoke, high-quality temperature and
time monitoring devices. Designed with precision and reliability, our products seamlessly integrate
into modern supply chains, ensuring that companies across healthcare, [food][53],
[pharmaceuticals][54], and more can monitor critical conditions efficiently.

We combine smart engineering with practical solutions, creating innovative devices that address your
specific needs – from concept to delivery.

[holtronic temperature indicator range]

## Explore our product range

Each Holtronic product is built for ease of use, accuracy, and compliance, ensuring that businesses
can maintain product integrity, regulatory adherence, and operational efficiency in
temperature-sensitive environments. [View all products →][55]

[
[neo blu data logger with bluetooth data report]

### Data Loggers: Contactless Cold Chain Monitoring

The Holtronic neo® Blu is a wireless electronic temperature data logger that transfers complete
breach records — including extent, duration and timing — contactlessly to any Android device. No
cables. No internet. No physical access to the device needed.

Read more
][56]
[
[reusable temperature indicators]

### Reusable Temperature Indicators

The Holtronic neo® Multi is the first electronic temperature and time indicator you can reset and
reuse — up to 90 times per unit. Purpose-built for return-to-base cold chains, it delivers the same
precision breach monitoring as a single-use device, at a fraction of the long-term cost.

Read more
][57]
[
[neo time temperature integrators 2-8ºC TTI for cold chain]

### Time-Temperature Integrators (TTIs) Explained: Shelf Life Calculation & Cold Chain Use

The Holtronic neo® TTI is an electronic time-temperature integrator that calculates the cumulative
thermal load experienced by your product, not just whether a threshold was breached, but what that
means for remaining shelf life. Purpose-built for pharmaceutical cold chain, with dedicated 2–8°C
configurations for vaccines, biologics and refrigerated medicines.

Read more
][58]
[
[single use indicators, electronic temperature indicators]

### Single Use Indicators

The Holtronic neo® Penta is a compact, single-use electronic temperature alarm indicator with up to
five programmable LED threshold alerts. At just 6g, with ±0.5°C accuracy, irreversible tamper-proof
breach records and a 2-year shelf life, it is the complete single-use cold chain monitoring solution
for pharmaceuticals, food safety and logistics.

Read more

## Circular Economy Manufacturing

Nexkemia is an innovative manufacturer of Expandable Polystyrene (EPS) resins, focused on
eco-friendly and circular material solutions. We develop high-performance products that minimize
environmental impact and align with global sustainability goals.

**The NexEco Product Line**

**30% Recycled Content**
Expandable Polystyrene resins containing 30% post-consumer and/or post-industrial mechanically
recycled materials.
* **Third Party verified**
* **UL2809 certification**
* **ASTM Tested**

### **No Compromise on Performance**

NexEco products maintain the same technical performance and final quality as virgin materials.

### **Sustainability as a Core Principle**

Nexkemia is dedicated to protecting the environment today and for the future by continuously
developing better environmental solutions.

### **Circular Economy in Action**

NexKemia goes beyond traditional manufacturing by managing the full circular process. Collecting,
recycling, and transforming materials into high-quality products ready for new use.

### **Sustainable EPS Solutions for Diverse Industries**

NexKemia’s innovative EPS resins serve key industries such as packaging, construction, automotive
and more. Each solution is designed to deliver high performance while supporting environmental
responsibility.

[Nexkmia plant - CMYK]

## Environmental Impact Reduction

### Eco Leverage

Every 1 kg of recycled resin avoids up to 4 kg of CO₂ emissions. For every 1 ton of recycled resin
use, up to 34 tons of waste can divert from landfills.

### Low Carbon Footprint

NexKemia processes use 100% renewable energy

### Strategic Advantage

By choosing Nexkemia’s innovative, circular, and eco-friendly solutions, customers strengthen their
position in eco-conscious markets and stay ahead of evolving regulations

[ Explore Nexkemia ][31]

### Our Synergy

## From concept to sustainability

**1. Cold chain packaging - Design and Development** Protect your temperature-sensitive products
with our cold chain expertise.


Cold Chain Packaging is vital for maintaining the integrity of temperature-sensitive products
throughout their journey. At Integreon, we specialize in innovative packaging solutions that ensure
pharmaceuticals and healthcare products remain within the required temperature range. Our Cryopak
division leverages advanced materials and design techniques to create packaging that safeguards your
products against temperature fluctuations, minimizing spoilage and maximizing shelf-life. With our
cold chain solutions, you can trust that your products will reach their destination in optimal
condition, ready for use. Partner with us and experience unparalleled quality in cold chain
logistics.

**2. Testing and Validation - Pharma and medical device testing** Ensure your products meet
regulatory standards with our testing solutions.


Our DDL division employs advanced testing capabilities and state of the art laboratory equipment to
evaluate the safety and compliance of your products. From R&D testing to Design Verification to full
package validations, we cover all early phase design verification activities and late phase
evaluations of primary and secondary packaging systems. Our experienced staff works diligently
across our 4 locations which are all ISO 17025 certified. Our vast network of controlled temperature
and humidity chambers allow projects to start faster reducing time to market. The data and results
we generate are reliable and accurate to empower our clients to make informed decisions. By choosing
DDL, you can be confident your product submission will pass regulatory scrutiny and achieve business
milestones!

**3. Circular Economy - Sustainable manufacturing** Embrace sustainability with our circular
manufacturing solutions.


 

At Integreon, we champion sustainability through our circular economy manufacturing processes. Our
NexKemia division focuses on transforming recycled polystyrene materials into high-quality products,
reducing waste and conserving resources. By embracing circular economy principles, we not only
create durable packaging solutions but also contribute to a healthier planet. Our innovative
approaches ensure that your products are not only effective but also environmentally responsible.
Join us in making a positive impact on the world while maintaining product integrity and
performance. Together, we can forge a sustainable future for generations to come.

**4. Lifecycle Management - Our R3 program** Reduce waste while enhancing performance


After use , Cryopak's return, refurbish, and recycle program recovers materials for recycling or
reusing in the making of new products while keeping the same certified high-performance. This
program includes cold chain packagin and cold chain monitoring. Our products go through rigourous
testing before being used again, ensuring quality performance and protection of your products.

**5. Integrated solutions - Use our Expertise** Experience seamless collaboration with our
integrated solutions for your product lifecycle.


 

Integreon brings together the expertise of Cryopak, DDL, and NexKemia to offer integrated solutions
that address every aspect of your product lifecycle. Our unified approach ensures seamless
collaboration among our specialized teams, delivering comprehensive support from concept to
sustainable end-of-life. We understand the complexities of the pharmaceutical and healthcare
industries, and our combined knowledge equips you to navigate challenges with confidence. By
leveraging our cohesive services, you can streamline processes, enhance product integrity, and
achieve your goals efficiently. Partner with us to experience the benefits of a truly integrated
service provider.

## One Point of Contact for Complete Solutions

### Empowering product integrity

As the parent company, Integreon coordinate all services between our sister companies, providing you
with a seamless experience and ensuring all components work together perfectly.

logistics.

**2. Testing and Validation - Pharma and medical device testing** Ensure your products meet
regulatory standards with our testing solutions.


Our DDL division employs advanced testing capabilities and state of the art laboratory equipment to
evaluate the safety and compliance of your products. From R&D testing to Design Verification to full
package validations, we cover all early phase design verification activities and late phase
evaluations of primary and secondary packaging systems. Our experienced staff works diligently
across our 4 locations which are all ISO 17025 certified. Our vast network of controlled temperature
and humidity chambers allow projects to start faster reducing time to market. The data and results
we generate are reliable and accurate to empower our clients to make informed decisions. By choosing
DDL, you can be confident your product submission will pass regulatory scrutiny and achieve business
milestones!

**3. Circular Economy - Sustainable manufacturing** Embrace sustainability with our circular
manufacturing solutions.


 

At Integreon, we champion sustainability through our circular economy manufacturing processes. Our
NexKemia division focuses on transforming recycled polystyrene materials into high-quality products,
reducing waste and conserving resources. By embracing circular economy principles, we not only
create durable packaging solutions but also contribute to a healthier planet. Our innovative
approaches ensure that your products are not only effective but also environmentally responsible.
Join us in making a positive impact on the world while maintaining product integrity and
performance. Together, we can forge a sustainable future for generations to come.

**4. Lifecycle Management - Our R3 program** Reduce waste while enhancing performance


After use , Cryopak's return, refurbish, and recycle program recovers materials for recycling or
reusing in the making of new products while keeping the same certified high-performance. This
program includes cold chain packagin and cold chain monitoring. Our products go through rigourous
testing before being used again, ensuring quality performance and protection of your products.

**5. Integrated solutions - Use our Expertise** Experience seamless collaboration with our
integrated solutions for your product lifecycle.


 

Integreon brings together the expertise of Cryopak, DDL, and NexKemia to offer integrated solutions
that address every aspect of your product lifecycle. Our unified approach ensures seamless
collaboration among our specialized teams, delivering comprehensive support from concept to
sustainable end-of-life. We understand the complexities of the pharmaceutical and healthcare
industries, and our combined knowledge equips you to navigate challenges with confidence. By
leveraging our cohesive services, you can streamline processes, enhance product integrity, and
achieve your goals efficiently. Partner with us to experience the benefits of a truly integrated
service provider.

with a seamless experience and ensuring all components work together perfectly.

expert consultation that help customers reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and outperform
legacy packaging systems.

## à la française

Née rue Royale à Paris, Ladurée célèbre l'élégance du goût à travers ses macarons et pâtisseries

Depuis 1862, la Maison Ladurée incarne la gourmandise dans l'art de vivre à la française.
Institution emblématique, elle relève chaque jour le défi d'allier tradition et innovation avec
excellence à travers ses créations.

# Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix

"The Global Specialized Industrial-Matrix (GSI-Matrix) is a premier international intelligence
portal dedicated to specialized manufacturing sectors including textiles, printing, papermaking, and
packaging. As a deep observer of ""System Integration"" capabilities in modern light industry and
infrastructure, GSI-Matrix aims to perfectly link vertical industry know-how with large-scale
production equipment through high-authority intelligence ""stitching.""

Strategic Intelligence Center: The Decision Brain for Vertical Industries. The ""Strategic
Intelligence Center"" at the heart of GSI-Matrix is the platform's soul. Driven by Textile Process
Engineers, Food Safety System Architects, and Industrial Economists, the center not only distributes
Latest Sector News—capturing dynamic adjustments in global pulp raw material fluctuations and food
packaging compliance standards—but also provides in-depth Evolutionary Trends reports. These analyze
color management paths in digital printing, nesting algorithms for automated woodworking machinery,
and the efficiency of brick-making machinery in low-carbon building material production. Our
Commercial Insights module reveals structural demand for basic capacity building and high-efficiency
consumer goods packaging lines in global emerging markets, assisting global distributors in
establishing technical prestige through professional intelligence.

Vision & Mission: Cultivating Industry, Linking Manufacture. The mission of GSI-Matrix is to ensure
that every production line and every process stage maximizes asset returns in the global specialized
industrial value chain through professional intelligence. We are committed to promoting the
intellectualization, modularization, and greening of niche manufacturing sectors, helping
enterprises achieve outstanding international brand influence in the tracks of ""Customized
Production"" and ""Mass Output"" through data-driven intelligence.
Our Slogan: Deep Cultivation in Vertical Lines, Intelligence Driving Manufacture."

We ensure seamless supply chain operations for your air logistics needs.

With our extensive global network of key ship carriers, we guarantee optimal space allocation and
competitive rates for your ocean cargo needs.

### Inland transport

Our in-country teams work closely with your vendors to monitor goods availability, arrange
collection and delivery, and ensure smooth inland transportation, navigating roads daily to prevent
disruptions in your supply chain.

trade.

specific to the market and with the integration of all processes, such as warehouse, transport, and
value-added services.

Our dedicated teams blend local knowledge and global expertise with leading-edge technology and
proven processes to create our competitive advantage.

Manufacturer for **savENRG® PCM Packs**, a sustainable series of phase change material based cold
chain refrigerants.

Protect your diagnostic and clinical trial samples from the risks of temperature excursion by
transporting them with **savENRG® PCM Packs**, a sustainable series of phase change material-based
cold chain refrigerants.

[home banner]

# Reduce the risk of temperature excursions with savENRG® PCM Packs

## **What happens when samples are exposed to extreme temperatures?**
1. **Delay of frozen samples shipped on dry-ice**Packages shipped on dry ice must be marked with a
   hazard label. The carrier generally will apply a dry ice surcharge. Also, most airlines have a
   restriction on how much dry ice is allowed onboard while freighters may carry more than passenger
   aircraft. Improper packaging of samples and restrictions on dry ice loading on airlines can lead
   to samples stranded on the tarmac. This can ultimately result in a delay in providing healthcare
   and increased cost in procuring another sample. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of delay
   of frozen samples shipped on dry ice [Read more…][16]
2. **Freezing of refrigerated and controlled room temperature (CRT) samples**Refrigerated and CRT
   samples can easily damage if frozen. Long exposure to winter ambient temperatures and freezing
   temperatures in airline cargo sections can reduce the temperature of refrigerated samples well
   below freezing. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of freezing samples [Read more…][17]

#### [Ice Packs][18]

Maintain frozen payloads below -20°C (-4°F)

[Read More...][19]

#### [Freezer Packs][20]

Maintain frozen payloads below -5°C (+23°F)

[Read More...][21]

#### [Cool Packs][22]

Maintain refrigerated payloads below +8°C (+46°F)

[Read More...][23]

#### [CRT Packs][24]

Provides freeze protection to CRT loads, maintaining temperature above +15°C (+59°F)

[Read More...][25]

#### [Ambient Packs][26]

Provides overheat protection, maintaining temperature below +25°C (+77°F)

[Read More...][27]

Manufacturer for **savENRG® PCM Packs**, a sustainable series of phase change material based cold
chain refrigerants.

Protect your diagnostic and clinical trial samples from the risks of temperature excursion by
transporting them with **savENRG® PCM Packs**, a sustainable series of phase change material-based
cold chain refrigerants.

[home banner]

# Reduce the risk of temperature excursions with savENRG® PCM Packs

## **What happens when samples are exposed to extreme temperatures?**
1. **Delay of frozen samples shipped on dry-ice**Packages shipped on dry ice must be marked with a
   hazard label. The carrier generally will apply a dry ice surcharge. Also, most airlines have a
   restriction on how much dry ice is allowed onboard while freighters may carry more than passenger
   aircraft. Improper packaging of samples and restrictions on dry ice loading on airlines can lead
   to samples stranded on the tarmac. This can ultimately result in a delay in providing healthcare
   and increased cost in procuring another sample. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of delay
   of frozen samples shipped on dry ice [Read more…][16]
2. **Freezing of refrigerated and controlled room temperature (CRT) samples**Refrigerated and CRT
   samples can easily damage if frozen. Long exposure to winter ambient temperatures and freezing
   temperatures in airline cargo sections can reduce the temperature of refrigerated samples well
   below freezing. Read more on how to mitigate this risk of freezing samples [Read more…][17]

#### [Ice Packs][18]

Maintain frozen payloads below -20°C (-4°F)

[Read More...][19]

#### [Freezer Packs][20]

Maintain frozen payloads below -5°C (+23°F)

[Read More...][21]

#### [Cool Packs][22]

Maintain refrigerated payloads below +8°C (+46°F)

[Read More...][23]

#### [CRT Packs][24]

Provides freeze protection to CRT loads, maintaining temperature above +15°C (+59°F)

[Read More...][25]

#### [Ambient Packs][26]

Provides overheat protection, maintaining temperature below +25°C (+77°F)

[Read More...][27]

## ABOUT Rika Sensor

Hunan Rika Electronic Tech Co., Ltd, located in Changsha, is a privately held weather sensor
manufacturer and solution provider of environmental & weather monitoring for 15+ years. 

 

Rika Sensor is committed to developing and providing intelligent and cost-effective IoT
environmental monitoring products and services, including: wind measurement, solar radiation
measurement, weather sensors, temperature and humidity measurement, hydro-meteorological
measurement, soil moisture measurement, water quality measurement, ICT liquid cooling water quality
monitoring, data loggers, environmental sensors and various weather stations and meteorological
monitoring stations.

 

All products are CE and RoHS certified, and have been widely deployed across supercomputing centers,
ICT liquid cooling systems, solar energy, smart agriculture, aquaculture, sewage treatment, air
quality monitoring, wind power generation and other meteorological and environmental monitoring
fields. The company holds full international management system certifications: ISO9001 (Quality
Management), ISO14001 (Environmental Management), ISO45001 (Occupational Health & Safety) and TUV.

manufacturer and solution provider of environmental & weather monitoring for 15+ years. 

 

Rika Sensor is committed to developing and providing intelligent and cost-effective IoT
environmental monitoring products and services, including: wind measurement, solar radiation
measurement, weather sensors, temperature and humidity measurement, hydro-meteorological
measurement, soil moisture measurement, water quality measurement, ICT liquid cooling water quality
monitoring, data loggers, environmental sensors and various weather stations and meteorological
monitoring stations.

ICT liquid cooling systems, solar energy, smart agriculture, aquaculture, sewage treatment, air
quality monitoring, wind power generation and other meteorological and environmental monitoring

Management), ISO14001 (Environmental Management), ISO45001 (Occupational Health & Safety) and TUV.
